description:
Give your skin everyday nourishment with the Daily Hydration Kit — a dermatologist-designed duo that gently cleanses, replenishes moisture, and supports a healthy skin barrier.

✨Why It Works 
This routine pairs lipid-rich Triple Milk Extracts with 10% Urea, a key component of the skin’s Natural Moisturizing Factor (NMF). Together, they hydrate, soften flaky skin, and maintain a balanced barrier.

✨What’s Inside
✅ Triple Milk Deep Hydrating Body Wash – A gentle cleanser that cleanses without stripping and restores essential moisture.
✅10% Urea Lotion – A dermatologist-approved hydrating lotion with 10% Urea + nourishing butters - all in a lightweight, non-greasy texture.

💫 The Result
Consistent, lasting hydration your skin can rely on!

Step 1:  Apply a generous amount of body wash to your palms or loofah. Massage onto wet skin in a circular motion.
Step 2: Rinse thoroughly after cleansing.
Step 3: Take a generous amount of lotion and massage onto your hands and feet, until absorbed.
Step 4: Massage an even layer all over the body until completely absorbed.

faqs.question: Can I use this Kit every day?
faqs.answer: Yes, we recommend using the bodywash and lotion kit for all skin types twice a day, every day.

faqs.question: Is this kit for all skin types?
faqs.answer: Yes - this lotion and bodywash can be used by all skin types, especially dry skin types

faqs.question: Can I use this twice a day?
faqs.answer: Yes, we recommend using it twice a day.

faqs.question: I have damaged skin, will it help me?
faqs.answer: This kit contains Urea lotion which is safe for sensitive skin. However, it is recommended to conduct a patch test and consult a dermatologist before use.

faqs.question: Can I use it right after a bath?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can use it any time of the day.
